fit: Uncentered SVD of eight discovery plural-minus-singular Attention5 final-position write differences. Nuisance basis from sixteen same-answer discovery differences. Mean direction and a fixed mean write also tested. Fit and save before running any intervention.
design: All discovery and lexical-transfer agreement endpoints; counterfactual and nuisance donors. Full swap and zero controls. PCA projections; nuisance and five random subspaces norm-matched to PCA projected perturbation at the same rank per case. Fixed mean tested only for counterfactual swaps.
fidelity: Internal relative error; KL(full-swap || approximation); margin and intended-group NLL errors against full swap; native-to-intervened KL and donor movement separately. Low-dimensional representation is not an upstream generator: projected coefficients use the actual donor difference.
scope: Eight nouns per split, one wording, whole attention output, paired directions dependent. No universal feature or canonical-basis claim.
criteria: Descriptive compact fidelity: mean absolute margin error <=10% of mean absolute full-swap effect AND mean reference KL <=10% of full-vs-native KL; do not convert passing into a semantic label.
